MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Customer Retention Manager to manage existing property-owner relationships, prevent avoidable cancellations, recover dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, and sell services that improve leasing results.
This is an individual-contributor position. You will manage a portfolio of existing clients—not a team of employees.

You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will monitor each property’s leasing progress, identify problems, recommend solutions, overcome resistance, and keep the relationship moving through tenant move-in.
This is not a basic customer-service position. You will be expected to challenge unrealistic expectations, handle difficult conversations, protect the client relationship, and obtain clear decisions.
Direct real-estate experience is preferred but not required. Strong retention and consultative-sales professionals from other service industries are encouraged to apply.
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive a link within 24–48 hours to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live scenario-based interview.
Manage a portfolio of existing property-owner relationships.
Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients before they cancel.
Investigate complaints and establish what happened.
Present realistic solutions and secure client decisions.
Explain listing activity, showing feedback, applications, and offers.
Persuade owners to make reasonable pricing changes.
Present qualified tenant offers and overcome objections.
Sell appropriate photography, video, maintenance, or property-improvement services.
Explain the financial effect of vacancy and delayed decisions.
Keep owners informed throughout the leasing process.
Coordinate requirements with tenants, realtors, vendors, the partner brokerage, and internal teams.
Manage multiple active files, deadlines, and follow-ups.
Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and next steps.
Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns appropriately.

Three or more years of experience in customer retention, account management, consultative sales, relationship management, customer success, insurance retention, telecommunications, financial services, hospitality, real estate, or another service-based industry.
Experience working with existing clients—not only acquiring new customers.
Demonstrated ability to save clients who were dissatisfied or considering cancellation.
Experience persuading clients to accept recommendations they initially resisted.
Experience selling additional services or solutions based on client needs.
Ability to use evidence, feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions.
Ability to remain calm when clients are angry, demanding, or blaming the company.
Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management.
Experience using a CRM or structured workflow system.
Sound judgment when handling escalations and sensitive client concerns.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Canadian real-estate experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
Revenue generated from appropriate additional services
The right person can listen to an upset client, establish the real issue, explain uncomfortable facts, and move the conversation toward a practical decision.

You must be persuasive without being misleading or overly aggressive. You should be comfortable defending the company when appropriate, acknowledging genuine service failures, and challenging a client when the evidence does not support their expectations.

You must also understand that retention does not mean agreeing to every demand. Strong judgment is required to know when to recover a relationship, when to reset expectations, and when an issue must be escalated.

As a Team Lead, Security Operations, you will own Deel's security operations pod end to end with an AI first mindset. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a globally distributed team of security analysts, set the strategy and metrics for how Deel detects and responds to threats, and stay hands-on at the same time, leading major incidents, hunting, and building detections alongside your team.

Govern managed security partner (MSSP) partner who provides 24x7 tier-one monitoring, and our in-house team across regions. You'll own that model completely: the escalation path, the partner relationship, the quality of every outcome, and the people who deliver it.

You will lead strategy to implementation of AI first security operations and response, from requirements and evaluation through data onboarding, detection parity, SOAR automation, cutover, and day-two operations. The pod's core responsibilities includes but not limited to threat hunting, insider threat, incident response, managing security events, purple teaming, phishing and email threat assessment across a remote-first, AWS-native environment.
r: Lead and manage the Security Operations pod. Coach, and develop a team of Security Analysts distributed across regions. Set goals, run performance and career conversations, and build a high-trust, blameless culture. Flex your working hours when needed so every team member gets real face time with their lead, regardless of time zone.

Own incident response end to end. Act as the escalation point and incident commander for high-severity incidents, define the severity matrix and runbooks, coordinate with Engineering, IT, Legal, and People teams during response, and run blameless post-incident reviews that drive remediation to closure.

Lead the SIEM/SOAR modernization program. Define requirements, run the evaluation, and lead the implementation, migration, and operationalization of a modern SIEM / AI SOC platform: log source inventory and onboarding, parsing and normalization, detection parity and detection-as-code, SOAR playbook migration, parallel run and cutover, cost and retention governance.

Govern the MSSP partnership. Own SLAs, escalation criteria, alert-tuning feedback loops, quality sampling of tier-one work, and QBRs. Make the handoff between 24x7 partner coverage and internal 24x5 response seamless and measurable.

Build and run the threat hunting and detection engineering program. Lead hypothesis-driven hunts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, own the detection lifecycle and coverage gap analysis, integrate threat intelligence and continuously tune to reduce alert fatigue.
